# SFCC-742 — Open Items Register

**Everything that must be confirmed before build starts. No assumptions carried.**

Compiled 2026-09-01 from both PreBuild passes (`findings.md`, `findings-addendum-2.md`) plus a
targeted re-check of the Design System's Textfield and Button component sets.

**37 items · 12 BLOCK-BUILD · 14 BLOCK-PR · 11 TRACK**

- **BLOCK-BUILD** — the answer changes what gets written. Cannot start the affected step.
- **BLOCK-PR** — build can proceed; the PR cannot be approved or the story closed without it.
- **TRACK** — no action needed from us; recorded so it is not rediscovered as a defect.

---

## First: seven things that are NOT questions

Do not spend anyone's goodwill on these. They were checked and are settled by evidence.

| | Settled by |
|---|---|
| **The boxed email field is fully specified.** The Textfield component set (`40000265:374`) has `Variant=Outline` alongside `Variant=Flush`, with all six states: Default `40000265:372`, Hover `:1738`, Focused `:2029`, Disabled `:2285`, Error `:2413`, Success `40003189:105941`. | Figma, re-checked 2026-09-01 |
| **`AppleIcon` / `GoogleIcon` exist** and are importable from `overrides/app/components/icons`. | `icons/index.tsx:41,56` |
| **Every colour, space and type value in the panel tokenises.** No new design token needs authoring. | `get_variable_defs` on `40001889:38489` vs `theme/foundation/` |
| **Tier profile: 9 Tier 3, 1 Tier 2, 0 Tier 1.** Only `theme/components/index.ts` needs a Tier 2 approver. | CODEOWNERS `:117`, `:176`, `:186` |
| **ACs 1, 2, 9, 10, 11 are mechanically satisfied** by Chakra's `Drawer` inside `ZimmDrawer` — focus trap, initial focus, focus restore, scroll lock, Escape/overlay close, `role="dialog"`. | `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` on PR #67 |
| **Small and Large variants are structurally identical.** Same three sections, two dividers, same order; only copy wrapping and vertical rhythm differ. | Rendered at 1400px / 900px |
| **No copy-first step applies.** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/` has no `ui-kits/` directory; this is 100% net-new. | Verified in first pass |

---

## A — Business Analyst · Jasmijn Tsang (reporter)

| # | Item | Status | What to ask |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A1** | **Is social sign-in actually in scope, and is Apple in or out?** `.docs/prd/checkout.md:39` and `:261` say *"Social login (Apple/Google): **Confirmed in scope for launch**"*. `.docs/prd/account.md:21` (**CRM-001**) says *"SSO (Apple/Google) is **not yet in scope** … treat as Open until confirmed"*, repeated at `:299`. Confluence **04.2 Design Tracker**, Checkout Entry row 07-07: *"marketing does not want apple login — need Rebecca to connect with marketing."* Figma and AC5 both require both buttons. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Which PRD is correct? Is Apple in for launch? Did Rebecca close the marketing objection? **One of the two PRDs needs correcting either way.** This decides whether we build two buttons, one, or none — and whether the `leadingIcon` atom work happens at all. |
| **A2** | **Does this component render a heading?** AC3 says *"displays a heading and explanatory copy"*. The design (all three sizes) opens directly with *"You must log in or create an account to add items to your wishlist."* — no heading. "WISHLIST" appears to be the drawer shell's tab title. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Confirm no heading element is rendered here. If it is, Step 3's markup and Step 4's assertions both change. Pairs with **C3**. |
| **A3** | **ACs 1, 2, 9, 10, 11 describe drawer-shell behaviour**, which the story's own scope note assigns to SFCC-736. They are satisfied by the shell, not by this component. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Formally reassign them to SFCC-434/SFCC-736, or restate them as assembly-level ACs. Without this, QA writes tests against SFCC-742 for behaviour it cannot own, and the story fails review for the wrong reason. |
| **A4** | **"Create an Account" — what does it do?** AC6 only requires the CTA be *visible*. No route, no target, no behaviour is specified anywhere in the ticket, the PRDs or Figma. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Even a content-only component needs the callback contract: does it navigate to a route, swap the drawer's content, or open a second drawer? |
| **A5** | **"Send Code" — what happens next?** Confluence 04.2 says the form should switch to *"the 6 code entry boxes"*. Figma's `Tab=Wishlist` has **only `Variant=Default`** — no Step 02/03, unlike `Tab=Find My Size` which has three. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Confirm the OTP code-entry screen is a separate story (SFCC-588?) and that SFCC-742 ships the Default state only, wired to a caller-supplied callback. |
| **A6** | **Final copy, verbatim.** Six strings: the explanatory line, `SEND CODE`, `SIGN IN WITH APPLE`, `SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE`, `NEW TO ZIMMERMANN?`, *"Join for exclusive offers, early access and a more personal experience."*, plus the `Email` field label. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Is this final, signed-off copy? Who owns it? It currently traces to **nothing but the Figma frame** — see A7. |
| **A7** | **No requirement ID.** SFCC-742's labels are only `Custom` + `Squad-A`. Every sibling carries one — SFCC-588/589/590 carry `CRM-001`, SFCC-347 carries `CFD-001/011`, SFCC-434 carries ten CRM IDs. | **BLOCK-PR** | Which requirement does this trace to? Needed for Zephyr traceability and to give the copy a source of truth other than a Figma frame. |
| **A8** | **Email validation rules and error copy.** No error node exists for this panel, though the Textfield Outline set does have `State=Error` (`40000265:2413`). | **BLOCK-PR** | Client-side validation rules, and the exact error message. Confirm we render the Outline/Error treatment. |
| **A9** | **Regional variation across 8 storefronts.** Is this panel identical everywhere? Social sign-in availability plausibly differs (HK, ME). | **BLOCK-PR** | Any storefront where Apple or Google must be hidden? If so it is a prop, not a constant. |
| **A10** | **Marketing opt-in / consent.** AGENTS.md: opt-in unchecked by default on all storefronts except US. The design shows no consent checkbox in the create-account path. | **BLOCK-PR** | Confirm no consent control belongs in this panel, and that opt-in is captured downstream in the account-creation flow. |
| **A11** | **`.docs/prd/cart.md` CAI-018 / CAI-004 / CAI-008** say guests attempting to wishlist are *"redirected to login"* / *"prompted to log in first"*. This story uses an in-place drawer. | **TRACK** | Different surface (cart vs PDP), and a drawer is arguably the prompt — but the PRD wording says redirect. Reconcile when cart.md is next touched. |
| **A12** | **WCAG version.** AC12 says **2.1 AA**; AGENTS.md targets **2.2 AA**, with 2.1 only as a documented fallback. | **TRACK** | Build to 2.2. Worth correcting the AC so the story template stops emitting 2.1. |
| **A13** | **Naming is inconsistent across the family.** Design: `pdp/drawer/content` `Tab=Wishlist`. Sibling SFCC-847: `drawer/content/filters`. This story: "Wishlist – Login Panel Content". | **TRACK** | Three conventions for one component family. Worth aligning before the other 13 tabs get written. |
| **A14** | **Ticket's Figma link points at the whole canvas** — `node-id=40000938-5082` is the `└– Drawer 🟢` page (3,116 frames), not the panel. | **TRACK** | Replace with the three node URLs: Large `40001889:38489`, Small `40001889:38498`, Mobile `40001897:40903`. |

---

## B — Design · Kiera (+ design lead)

| # | Item | Status | What to ask |
|---|---|---|---|
| **B1** | **Exact email-field configuration.** The Textfield `Variant=Outline, Text Config=Placeholder, State=Default` node (`40000265:372`) renders **four things**: a small floated "Label" inside the box, placeholder text, a **× clear affordance**, and a **helper-text row below**. The wishlist panel's field shows **none of those** — just "Email". | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Is the wishlist field `Text Config=Label` (floated "Email", empty input) or `Text Config=Placeholder`? Are the × clear button and the helper-text row **suppressed**, or just not drawn in the comp? This is the single highest-risk visual detail — the two readings look different and both are plausible from the render. |
| **B2** | **Confirm Outline is the right variant**, and note **`Inverse=True` exists only for `Variant=Flush`** — there is no inverse Outline member. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Confirm; and confirm no inverse boxed input is ever needed, since we would have to invent it. |
| **B3** | **Apple / Google glyph assets.** The design draws both **solid black**. Shipped base-template assets don't match: `apple.svg` is 24×24 with a hardcoded `fill="#181818"` (**not `currentColor`**, so it cannot inherit the button's text colour); `google.svg` is 28×28 and is Google's official **four-colour** mark (`#4285f4` `#34a853` `#e94235` `#fbbc04`). | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Supply the intended marks as assets. Per AGENTS.md > Rules > Icons we must not substitute a visually different icon — and we must not silently recolour a third-party brand mark to match a comp. |
| **B4** | **Brand-compliance exposure — needs a real answer, not a preference.** Google's Sign-In branding guidelines generally permit only the four-colour G or an all-white G on an approved background; **a solid black G is typically not an approved treatment.** Apple's HIG constrains the "Sign in with Apple" button — mark, copy, height, corner radius and margins. **The design as drawn may be non-compliant with both vendors.** | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Has anyone checked both vendors' current guidelines? If the comp is non-compliant we are shipping a legal/brand risk, not a styling choice. Escalate beyond design if needed. |
| **B5** | **Glyph↔label gap** on the social buttons. No measured Figma value is available, and `overrideStyling.md` forbids inventing one. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Give the spacing value, or confirm Chakra's default `leftIcon` gap is acceptable. |
| **B6** | **Does the glyph recolour with the label** on hover / active / disabled? `Tab=Wishlist` has only `Variant=Default`, so no node answers this. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | If yes, the glyph needs a `currentColor` fill and the base-template assets will not honour it — which feeds back into B3. |
| **B7** | **Missing panel states.** `Tab=Wishlist` has **only `Variant=Default`**. There is no design for: AC8's *"content fails to load"*, a pending/loading state on SEND CODE (an async call in the real flow), or a panel-level error. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Supply them, or explicitly waive each one in writing so the waiver is the record rather than our inference. |
| **B8** | **Divider colour conflict.** Figma `alias/color/border/secondary` = **`#dddddd`**. Repo `border.secondary` → `grey[200]` = **`#d1d1d1`** (`theme/foundation/colour.ts:13`, `:73`). Same alias name, two values, both citing "Zimmermann Design System 2026" as source. The panel has two dividers. | **BLOCK-PR** | Which is authoritative — has the Figma moved since the Handover port, or did the port drift? `colour.ts` is **Tier 1**; we will not change it unilaterally. |
| **B9** | **Button dimensions — long outstanding.** Figma/Handover `alias/size/action/height/1300` = **52px** (`actionSizes.height.lg`). `zimmButton.css.ts:205` ships **`BTN_HEIGHT_LG = '50px'`**, plus `BTN_HEIGHT_SM = '41px'` against a Handover 40px, and `BTN_PADDING_Y = '5px'` with no token at all. All four CTAs in this panel render 2px short. | **BLOCK-PR** | Sign off or correct. Flagged in-code as *"pending UI-designer sign-off"* since 2026-08-18. A Figma-vs-build measurement pass on this panel will read it as a defect. |
| **B10** | **Unframed tablet band.** Frames are Large 522, Small 342, Mobile 342. Breakpoints are 768 / 860 / 1024. Small and Mobile **share a width** and differ only in height, so the mapping is not derivable from the frames. | **BLOCK-PR** | Which frame governs **768–1022**? This band covers three iPad models in portrait and has broken before. |
| **B11** | **Is the design actually locked?** Confluence **04.72** schedules Wishlist design lock **Sep 21** and stories ready for dev **Oct 5**. This story is in **Sprint 4, which ends Sep 7** — roughly five weeks ahead of the tracker's own plan. The Drawer canvas is marked `🟢`. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Confirm `🟢` means signed off and that this panel will not move. 04.72's stated hard rule is that stories are only written against locked designs. |

---

## C — Tech Lead / dependency owners · Tim Lavelle (SFCC-736), SFCC-434 owner

| # | Item | Status | What to ask |
|---|---|---|---|
| **C1** | **PR #67 is `REVIEW_REQUIRED` *and* `mergeable: CONFLICTING`** as of 2026-09-01 (last push 2026-08-31; `develop` has since moved to `f7fd816`). `ZimmDrawer`, `ZimmTabs`, `ZimmPdpDrawer` exist only on that branch. | **BLOCK-PR** | When does it land, and **is the `ZimmDrawer` / `ZimmPdpDrawer` prop contract frozen?** We are designing a seam against an API that is still in review. |
| **C2** | **`ZimmPdpDrawer` does not thread `size` to its tab content.** It passes `size` to `ZimmDrawer` and `ZimmTabs`, but `activeTab.content` is a pre-built `ReactNode`. So whoever assembles the tabs array must set this panel's `size` at construction time. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Is that the intended contract, or should #67 thread `size` into the content node? Determines this component's public API. |
| **C3** | **Which shell wraps this panel — `ZimmDrawer` + a title, or `ZimmPdpDrawer` + a single tab?** `ZimmPdpDrawer` requires a tab label; `ZimmDrawer` requires `labelledBy`/`aria-label`. | **BLOCK-BUILD** | Decides whether a tab bar renders above the content and therefore where "WISHLIST" lives. **Directly determines A2's answer.** |
| **C4** | **Where do ACs 1/2/9/10/11 get asserted, and by whom?** They are shell behaviours with no home on this story. | **BLOCK-PR** | Confirm E2E coverage sits on SFCC-434, and that it exists. Otherwise these ACs are simply never tested. |
| **C5** | **The `pdp/drawer/content` family is 15 tabs**, not one — Filters (SFCC-847), Notify Me, Find In Boutique, Find My Size, Details & Care, Shipping & Returns, Assistance, Cookies Settings, EU Environmental Qualities, Back In Stock Notify, Size & Fit, and three Regional Storefront variants. Note PR #67 put Details & Care in `pages/product-detail/partials/`, not `ui-kits/`. | **BLOCK-PR** | Should these content components share a common wrapper or contract, and which folder do they live in? **SFCC-742 sets the precedent the other 13 follow.** Worth 20 minutes now. |

---

## D — Scrum Master / delivery · Hazel Marie Cacalda

| # | Item | Status | What to ask |
|---|---|---|---|

content.text:
**36 items. 19 block the build, 14 block the PR, 6 are just tracked.** Register is attached and grouped by owner so you can lift each section straight into a message.

### Start with one question

**A1 — is social sign-in actually in scope, and is Apple in or out?** Three sources disagree:

- `checkout.md:39`/`:261` — *"Social login (Apple/Google): Confirmed in scope for launch"*
- `account.md:21` (CRM-001) — *"SSO (Apple/Google) is not yet in scope… treat as Open"*
- Confluence 04.2, Checkout Entry 07-07 — *"marketing does not want apple login — need Rebecca to connect with marketing"*

Figma and AC5 both draw both buttons anyway. **If Apple is out, five of the eleven designer questions disappear** along with most of Step 1. Asking Kiera about glyph assets before Jasmijn answers this wastes her time.

### The one I'd flag hardest

**B4 — brand compliance.** The design draws both marks solid black. Google's Sign-In guidelines generally permit only the four-colour G or an all-white G on an approved background; a solid black G typically isn't approved. Apple's HIG constrains the button's mark, copy, height, corner radius and margins. **The comp as drawn may be non-compliant with both vendors.** That's legal/brand exposure, not a styling preference — and nobody appears to have checked.

### One item left the list rather than joining it

I re-checked the Design System before writing this, and the **boxed email field is fully specified** — the Textfield set has `Variant=Outline` alongside `Variant=Flush`, with all six states (Default `40000265:372`, Hover, Focused, Disabled, Error, Success). So Step 1b needs no designer input for the variant itself.

But that same check produced the **highest-risk visual item, B1**: the Outline/Placeholder node renders a floated label, placeholder text, a **× clear button**, and a **helper-text row below**. The wishlist panel shows none of those — just "Email". Both readings are plausible from the comp and they look different. Worth noting the earlier pass recorded this as "floating label"; I don't think that's safe to rely on.

### Also worth knowing

- **D4 — re-estimate.** 3 points was set on 25 Aug, before either atom gap was known. The story now carries two shared-atom extensions on top of the organism.
- **D2** — the story is assigned to Jersey, not you. Worth settling before any commit.
- **C5** — this panel is 1 of **15** tabs in the same `pdp/drawer/content` set. Whatever shape SFCC-742 takes, the other 13 follow it. Note PR #67 put Details & Care in `pages/product-detail/partials/`, not `ui-kits/` — so the precedent is already split. That's a 20-minute conversation now or a refactor later.

Nothing is being built until these come back.

# SFCC-742 — Measured design spec

Derived 2026-09-01 from the 33 nodes Marcel supplied, Design System 2026 `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm`.

**Measurement discipline** (FED handbook §5): every number below comes from a **FRAME or INSTANCE**
— a real box, directly comparable to a CSS box. TEXT nodes report a **cap-height** box and are
**excluded** from all vertical figures; where a text node's height is quoted it is labelled as such
and must not be used as a CSS height. Horizontal `x` positions are real for all node types.
Only `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` was read — no cross-file comparison.

---

## 1. Structure — identical across all three sizes

```
Size={Large|Small|Mobile}, Tab=Wishlist, Variant=Default
├─ Content
│  ├─ Description            text, 1 line @ Large / 2 lines @ Small+Mobile
│  └─ Email Form
│     ├─ instance "Input forms"   ← the email field
│     └─ instance "Button"        ← SEND CODE
├─ line "Divider"                 ← divider 1
├─ instance "Button-group"        ← Apple + Google
└─ Total Container
   ├─ line "Divider"              ← divider 2
   └─ Sign up
      ├─ text "Sub header"        ← NEW TO ZIMMERMANN?
      ├─ text "Body"
      └─ instance "Button"        ← CREATE AN ACCOUNT
```

Node IDs — Large `40001889:38489` · Small `40001889:38498` · Mobile `40001897:40903`.

---

## 2. Measurements

| | **Large** | **Small** | **Mobile** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Panel | **522 × 523** | **342 × 559** | **342 × 503** |
| Email field (`Input forms`) | 522 × **48** | 342 × **48** | 342 × **48** |
| SEND CODE button | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| Social button (each) | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| `Button-group` total | 522 × **120** | 342 × **120** | 342 × **96** |
| CREATE AN ACCOUNT | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| Divider 1 width | **387** ⚠️ | 342 (full) | 342 (full) |
| Divider 2 width | 522 (full) | 342 (full) | 342 (full) |
| Gap: divider 2 → Sign up | **24** | **24** | **16** |

### Vertical rhythm — consistent everywhere

| Gap | Value | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Description → Email Form | **32** | `--zimm-scale-2xl` (`alias/space/800`) |
| Email field → SEND CODE | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` (`alias/space/400`) |
| Content → divider 1 | **40** | `--zimm-scale-3xl` (`alias/space/1000`) |
| Divider 1 → Button-group | **40** | `--zimm-scale-3xl` |
| Button-group → Total Container | **40** | `--zimm-scale-3xl` |
| Between the two social buttons | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` |
| Sub header → Body | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` |
| Body → CREATE AN ACCOUNT | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` |
| Divider 2 → Sign up | **24** L/S · **16** Mobile | `--zimm-scale-xl` / `--zimm-scale-m` |

Every value maps to an existing token. **No new spacing token is needed.**

---

## 3. The email field — B1, closed

`Input forms` instance (Large `40001851:13931`) contains **exactly one child**:

```
<instance "Input forms" 522 × 48>
  <text "Input label" x=16 y=17 w=299 h=14>
```

- **48px tall box** — constant across all three sizes.
- **One text node.** No `×` clear affordance. No helper-text row. No separate floated label.
- **16px left inset** (`--zimm-scale-m`).
- Vertically centred: 17 above, 17 below a 14-tall text box in 48.
- Border colour `alias/color/field/border/default` `#707070` = `grey[500]` = `var(--zimm-color-border-forms)` — already correct in-repo.

**This is not the Textfield set's 61px `Outline / Default`** (which renders label + placeholder + clear
button + helper row, node `40000265:372`). It is a reduced 48px configuration.

**Remaining sliver:** 48px cannot accommodate a floated label *plus* input text — the floating-label
Outline variant is 61px. So the resting "Email" is almost certainly a **placeholder**, not a floating
label. `ZimmTextInput` is a floating-label component. **Confirm with Kiera before Step 1b** — see
open item **B1-a** below.

---

## 4. The social buttons — B5, closed

Apple button instance `I40002218:80004;40002218:79447` (522 × 52):

```
frame "Icon leading"  x=189 y=18  16 × 16   → instance "Icon_Apple" 16 × 16
text  "Label"         x=209 y=21.5 124 × 9  (cap box — height not usable)
frame "Icon trailing" x=32        16 × 16   hidden
```

- **Icon is 16 × 16** — matches `iconSizes.md` (16px) and `ZimmButton`'s existing `ICON_SIZE_DEFAULT`.
- **Glyph → label gap = 4px** (`209 − (189 + 16)`) = `--zimm-scale-2xs` (`alias/space/100`).
- Icon vertically centred (18 / 16 / 18 in 52).
- **Content block is horizontally centred**, not left-aligned: content spans 189→333 = 144 wide,
  and `(522 − 144) / 2 = 189` exactly.
- **The Design System's Button component already has `Icon leading` and `Icon trailing` slots.**
  Adding `leadingIcon` to `ZimmButton` is therefore *matching the design system*, not inventing an
  API — good supporting evidence for plan §0.1. Consider naming the prop to match (`iconLeading`).
- `Button-group` (`40002218:80004`) is **its own DS component**, containing a third **hidden** 246px
  half-width button — a side-by-side alternate that is switched off. Relevant to **SFCC-590**.
- The glyph is `Icon_Apple`, a **Design System** component — *not* the base-template `AppleIcon`
  currently in the overrides barrel. Parity still unverified (**B3**).

---

## 5. The drawer shell — A2 / C3, closed

From `pdp/drawer/large` (`40002846:8337`) and `pdp/drawer/mobile` (`40002866:76150`):

```
pdp/drawer
├─ pdp/drawer/header      720 × 120  (Large)   |  402 × 88  (Mobile)
│  └─ drawer/header       x=64 y=48            |  x=32 y=32
│     ├─ Menu  →  N × instance "drawer/nav-item"   ← a TAB BAR
│     └─ instance "Icon_close"  20 × 20            ← right-aligned
└─ pdp/drawer/content     y=120                |  y=88
```

**There is no title text node anywhere in `pdp/drawer/header`, at any size.** Visually confirmed by
rendering `40002846:8380`: the header is a horizontal tab row — DETAILS & CARE (underlined = active),
SIZE GUIDE, FIND MY SIZE, SHIPPING & RETURNS, ASSISTANCE, QU… (overflow) — with a `×` at the right.

**Therefore:**
- **A2 — the content component renders no heading.** Confirmed by structure and by render.
- **C3 — the shell is the tabbed one** (`ZimmPdpDrawer` shape). The close control lives in the
  header, so ACs 1/2 are shell-owned exactly as the plan assumed.

---

## 6. Responsive — B10, partially closed

Designer annotation `40003865:128794`, sitting beside the `pdp/drawer/large` frames:

```
DESKTOP = 80-82%
DESKTOP = 50%
DESKTOP = 25%
TABLET  = 80%
MOBILE  = HUG
```

So drawer width is **percentage-of-viewport**, and **tablet is explicitly specified at 80%** — the
unframed 768–1022 band is *not* undefined after all, at least for the shell.

Confirmed against the templates: `PDP Drawer Template - Small (25%)` (`40003398:43537`) holds a
`pdp/drawer` instance **402** wide inside a 1440 frame; `pdp/drawer/large` is **720** = 50% of 1440.

Content insets follow: Small/Mobile drawer 402 − content 342 = **30px each side**. Large drawer
720 − content 522 = 99 each side, which does **not** match the header's 64px inset — see **B10-a**.

---

## 7. Findings that were not on any prior list

| | Finding | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| **N1** | **Mobile uses 40px buttons; Large and Small use 52px.** | The `size` prop changes **button size**, not just layout. Both plan and register assumed layout-only. Step 3 must pass `size="medium"` to `ZimmButton` at Mobile and `size="large"` otherwise. |
| **N2** | **Large's divider 1 is 387px wide, not 522** — while Large's divider 2 *is* 522, and Small and Mobile have both dividers at full width. | 387/522 = 74%. Inconsistent with its own sibling variants. Almost certainly a **design slip**, but we must not silently "correct" it (handbook §5: *"A design nudge is still spec"*). **Ask.** |
| **N3** | **Mobile's Sign-up block sits 16px below divider 2; Large and Small sit 24px.** | A third size-specific value beyond width and button height. |
| **N4** | **`Button-group` is a DS component** with a hidden 246px half-width alternate. | SFCC-590 may be meant to build *this*, not two loose buttons. |
| **N5** | **Regional drawer variants exist** — `EU storefront - default`, `EU storefront - paginated`, `Default - non EU storefront` (all 720 × 1026, `40003085:34135/34162/34198`). | Direct evidence for **A9**. Drawer content *does* vary by region somewhere in this family. Worth checking whether wishlist is affected. |
| **N6** | A cart-drawer node is named **"Discount code - no marketing tick box"** (`40004302:129672`). | Implies a *with*-tick-box variant exists. Feeds **A10** (marketing opt-in). |
| **N7** | **`Icon_close` is 20 × 20** and right-aligned in the header. | Shell detail; useful when reconciling against PR #67's `ZimmDrawer` close button. |

---

## 8. Still open after this pass

| # | Item | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| **B1-a** | The email field is 48px with one vertically-centred text at 16px inset. Is that a **placeholder** (text disappears on typing) or a **floating label** (text shrinks and moves up)? 48px cannot fit a floated label plus input text — the floating-label Outline variant is 61px — so it reads as a placeholder, but `ZimmTextInput` is a floating-label component and this changes its behaviour. | Kiera |
| **B3 / B6** | `Icon_Apple` / `Icon_Google` are **Design System** components; the overrides barrel has base-template `AppleIcon` / `GoogleIcon` (Apple hardcoded `#181818`, Google four-colour). Supply the DS assets. Does the glyph recolour with the label on hover / active / disabled? | Kiera |
| **B4** | **Brand compliance.** Unchanged and still the highest-exposure item — a solid black Google G is generally not an approved treatment, and Apple's HIG constrains the button. | Design + brand/legal |
| **B7** | No error, loading/pending, or AC8 "failed to load" state exists for `Tab=Wishlist`. | Kiera |
| **B8** | Divider colour `#dddddd` (Figma) vs `#d1d1d1` (repo `grey[200]`). Tier 1. | UI designer |
| **B9** | **Now measured, not inferred:** design says **52px** (Large/Small) and **40px** (Mobile). Repo ships `BTN_HEIGHT_LG = 50px` and `BTN_HEIGHT_SM = 41px`. **Both are wrong for this panel.** | UI designer |
| **B10-a** | Drawer is **80% at tablet**, but `Tab=Wishlist` has **no Tablet variant** — only Large/Small/Mobile (the component set does define `Tablet`, `Extra Large`, `X-Large` for other tabs). Which content variant renders at 768–1022? Also: Large's 99px content inset vs the header's 64px inset — which is right? | Kiera |
| **B11** | Is the design locked? Confluence 04.72 schedules Wishlist design lock **Sep 21**; this is Sprint 4, ending Sep 7. | Design lead |

# SFCC-742 — Measured design spec

Derived 2026-09-01 from the 33 nodes Marcel supplied, Design System 2026 `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm`.

**Measurement discipline** (FED handbook §5): every number below comes from a **FRAME or INSTANCE**
— a real box, directly comparable to a CSS box. TEXT nodes report a **cap-height** box and are
**excluded** from all vertical figures; where a text node's height is quoted it is labelled as such
and must not be used as a CSS height. Horizontal `x` positions are real for all node types.
Only `wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` was read — no cross-file comparison.

---

## 1. Structure — identical across all three sizes

```
Size={Large|Small|Mobile}, Tab=Wishlist, Variant=Default
├─ Content
│  ├─ Description            text, 1 line @ Large / 2 lines @ Small+Mobile
│  └─ Email Form
│     ├─ instance "Input forms"   ← the email field
│     └─ instance "Button"        ← SEND CODE
├─ line "Divider"                 ← divider 1
├─ instance "Button-group"        ← Apple + Google
└─ Total Container
   ├─ line "Divider"              ← divider 2
   └─ Sign up
      ├─ text "Sub header"        ← NEW TO ZIMMERMANN?
      ├─ text "Body"
      └─ instance "Button"        ← CREATE AN ACCOUNT
```

Node IDs — Large `40001889:38489` · Small `40001889:38498` · Mobile `40001897:40903`.

---

## 2. Measurements

| | **Large** | **Small** | **Mobile** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Panel | **522 × 523** | **342 × 559** | **342 × 503** |
| Email field (`Input forms`) | 522 × **48** | 342 × **48** | 342 × **48** |
| SEND CODE button | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| Social button (each) | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| `Button-group` total | 522 × **120** | 342 × **120** | 342 × **96** |
| CREATE AN ACCOUNT | 522 × **52** | 342 × **52** | 342 × **40** |
| Divider 1 width | **387** ⚠️ | 342 (full) | 342 (full) |
| Divider 2 width | 522 (full) | 342 (full) | 342 (full) |
| Gap: divider 2 → Sign up | **24** | **24** | **16** |

### Vertical rhythm — consistent everywhere

| Gap | Value | Token |
|---|---|---|
| Description → Email Form | **32** | `--zimm-scale-2xl` (`alias/space/800`) |
| Email field → SEND CODE | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` (`alias/space/400`) |
| Content → divider 1 | **40** | `--zimm-scale-3xl` (`alias/space/1000`) |
| Divider 1 → Button-group | **40** | `--zimm-scale-3xl` |

| Sub header → Body | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` |
| Body → CREATE AN ACCOUNT | **16** | `--zimm-scale-m` |
| Divider 2 → Sign up | **24** L/S · **16** Mobile | `--zimm-scale-xl` / `--zimm-scale-m` |

Every value maps to an existing token. **No new spacing token is needed.**

---

## 3. The email field — B1, closed

`Input forms` instance (Large `40001851:13931`) contains **exactly one child**:

```
<instance "Input forms" 522 × 48>
  <text "Input label" x=16 y=17 w=299 h=14>
```

- **48px tall box** — constant across all three sizes.
- **One text node.** No `×` clear affordance. No helper-text row. No separate floated label.
- **16px left inset** (`--zimm-scale-m`).
- Vertically centred: 17 above, 17 below a 14-tall text box in 48.
- Border colour `alias/color/field/border/default` `#707070` = `grey[500]` = `var(--zimm-color-border-forms)` — already correct in-repo.

**This is not the Textfield set's 61px `Outline / Default`** (which renders label + placeholder + clear
button + helper row, node `40000265:372`). It is a reduced 48px configuration.

**Remaining sliver:** 48px cannot accommodate a floated label *plus* input text — the floating-label
Outline variant is 61px. So the resting "Email" is almost certainly a **placeholder**, not a floating
label. `ZimmTextInput` is a floating-label component. **Confirm with Kiera before Step 1b** — see
open item **B1-a** below.

---

## 4. The social buttons — B5, closed

Apple button instance `I40002218:80004;40002218:79447` (522 × 52):

```
frame "Icon leading"  x=189 y=18  16 × 16   → instance "Icon_Apple" 16 × 16
text  "Label"         x=209 y=21.5 124 × 9  (cap box — height not usable)
frame "Icon trailing" x=32        16 × 16   hidden
```

- **Icon is 16 × 16** — matches `iconSizes.md` (16px) and `ZimmButton`'s existing `ICON_SIZE_DEFAULT`.
- **Glyph → label gap = 4px** (`209 − (189 + 16)`) = `--zimm-scale-2xs` (`alias/space/100`).
- Icon vertically centred (18 / 16 / 18 in 52).
- **Content block is horizontally centred**, not left-aligned: content spans 189→333 = 144 wide,

- **The Design System's Button component already has `Icon leading` and `Icon trailing` slots.**

- `Button-group` (`40002218:80004`) is **its own DS component**, containing a third **hidden** 246px
  half-width button — a side-by-side alternate that is switched off. Relevant to **SFCC-590**.
- The glyph is `Icon_Apple`, a **Design System** component — *not* the base-template `AppleIcon`
  currently in the overrides barrel. Parity still unverified (**B3**).

---

## 5. The drawer shell — A2 / C3, closed

From `pdp/drawer/large` (`40002846:8337`) and `pdp/drawer/mobile` (`40002866:76150`):

```
pdp/drawer
├─ pdp/drawer/header      720 × 120  (Large)   |  402 × 88  (Mobile)
│  └─ drawer/header       x=64 y=48            |  x=32 y=32
│     ├─ Menu  →  N × instance "drawer/nav-item"   ← a TAB BAR
│     └─ instance "Icon_close"  20 × 20            ← right-aligned
└─ pdp/drawer/content     y=120                |  y=88
```

**There is no title text node anywhere in `pdp/drawer/header`, at any size.** Visually confirmed by
rendering `40002846:8380`: the header is a horizontal tab row — DETAILS & CARE (underlined = active),
SIZE GUIDE, FIND MY SIZE, SHIPPING & RETURNS, ASSISTANCE, QU… (overflow) — with a `×` at the right.

**Therefore:**
- **A2 — the content component renders no heading.** Confirmed by structure and by render.
- **C3 — the shell is the tabbed one** (`ZimmPdpDrawer` shape). The close control lives in the
  header, so ACs 1/2 are shell-owned exactly as the plan assumed.

---

## 6. Responsive — B10, partially closed

Designer annotation `40003865:128794`, sitting beside the `pdp/drawer/large` frames:

```
DESKTOP = 80-82%
DESKTOP = 50%
DESKTOP = 25%
TABLET  = 80%
MOBILE  = HUG
```

So drawer width is **percentage-of-viewport**, and **tablet is explicitly specified at 80%** — the
unframed 768–1022 band is *not* undefined after all, at least for the shell.

Confirmed against the templates: `PDP Drawer Template - Small (25%)` (`40003398:43537`) holds a
`pdp/drawer` instance **402** wide inside a 1440 frame; `pdp/drawer/large` is **720** = 50% of 1440.

Content insets follow: Small/Mobile drawer 402 − content 342 = **30px each side**. Large drawer
720 − content 522 = 99 each side, which does **not** match the header's 64px inset — see **B10-a**.

---

## 7. Findings that were not on any prior list

| | Finding | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| **N1** | **Mobile uses 40px buttons; Large and Small use 52px.** | The `size` prop changes **button size**, not just layout. Both plan and register assumed layout-only. Step 3 must pass `size="medium"` to `ZimmButton` at Mobile and `size="large"` otherwise. |
| **N2** | **Large's divider 1 is 387px wide, not 522** — while Large's divider 2 *is* 522, and Small and Mobile have both dividers at full width. | 387/522 = 74%. Inconsistent with its own sibling variants. Almost certainly a **design slip**, but we must not silently "correct" it (handbook §5: *"A design nudge is still spec"*). **Ask.** |
| **N3** | **Mobile's Sign-up block sits 16px below divider 2; Large and Small sit 24px.** | A third size-specific value beyond width and button height. |
| **N4** | **`Button-group` is a DS component** with a hidden 246px half-width alternate. | SFCC-590 may be meant to build *this*, not two loose buttons. |
| **N5** | **Regional drawer variants exist** — `EU storefront - default`, `EU storefront - paginated`, `Default - non EU storefront` (all 720 × 1026, `40003085:34135/34162/34198`). | Direct evidence for **A9**. Drawer content *does* vary by region somewhere in this family. Worth checking whether wishlist is affected. |
| **N6** | A cart-drawer node is named **"Discount code - no marketing tick box"** (`40004302:129672`). | Implies a *with*-tick-box variant exists. Feeds **A10** (marketing opt-in). |
| **N7** | **`Icon_close` is 20 × 20** and right-aligned in the header. | Shell detail; useful when reconciling against PR #67's `ZimmDrawer` close button. |

## Design confidence: substantially up. Two of those nodes stopped us shipping defects.

### Closed outright

**A2 + C3 — the heading question, both gone.** `pdp/drawer/header` contains a `Menu` of `drawer/nav-item` instances and an `Icon_close`, at every size. **There is no title text node anywhere in it.** Rendered it to be sure: the header is a tab row — DETAILS & CARE, SIZE GUIDE, FIND MY SIZE, SHIPPING & RETURNS, ASSISTANCE, overflow — with a `×` right-aligned. So the content component renders no heading, and the shell is the tabbed one. Both were BLOCK-BUILD.

**B1 — the email field.** One child node: `text "Input label" x=16 y=17 w=299 h=14` inside a 48px box. No clear button, no helper row, no floated label, 16px inset, vertically centred. Down to a single confirm (below).

**B5 — the glyph gap is 4px.** Icon `16×16` at x=189, label at x=209. Content block is *centred*, not left-aligned — 144px wide in 522, and `(522−144)/2 = 189` exactly.

### Two findings that would have shipped as bugs

**Mobile uses 40px buttons. Large and Small use 52px.** The `size` prop changes *button size*, not just layout — both the plan and the register assumed layout-only. Step 3 has to pass `size="medium"` at Mobile.

**Large's first divider is 387px wide, not 522.** Its *second* divider is 522, and Small and Mobile have both at full width. So it's inconsistent with its own siblings — 74% width, almost certainly a slip. But per the handbook, a design nudge is still spec; we don't silently correct it.

### The spacing system is fully derived

40px between sections, 32 description→form, 16 within groups, 24 (Large/Small) or 16 (Mobile) after the second divider. **Every value maps to an existing token** — `3xl`/`2xl`/`xl`/`m`. No new spacing token needed.

### Also worth flagging

- **`TABLET = 80%`** — there's a designer annotation giving drawer width per breakpoint (Desktop 80-82% / 50% / 25%, Tablet 80%, Mobile hug). The tablet band isn't undefined after all. But `Tab=Wishlist` has **no Tablet variant**, so which content variant renders at 768–1022 is now a sharp new question.
- **B9 is no longer inference.** Design says 52px and 40px; the repo ships 50px and 41px. Both wrong for this panel, measured off instances.
- **The DS Button already has `Icon leading`/`Icon trailing` slots.** Adding `leadingIcon` to `ZimmButton` is matching the design system, not inventing an API — worth saying in the PR.
- **`Button-group` is its own DS component** with a hidden 246px half-width alternate. SFCC-590 may be meant to build *that*.
- **Regional drawer variants exist** — `EU storefront - default`, `EU storefront - paginated`, `Default - non EU storefront`. That's real evidence for A9, which I'd previously only raised as a hypothesis.

### Still open — and one gap in the node set

Ten items, listed in §8 of the spec. The three I'd push hardest:

1. **B1-a** — is that 48px field a **placeholder** or a **floating label**? 48px can't fit a floated label plus input text (that variant is 61px), so it reads as a placeholder — but `ZimmTextInput` is a floating-label component, so this changes its behaviour. Gates Step 1b.
2. **C3-a** — **none of the 33 nodes is an assembled *wishlist* drawer.** Every assembled frame you sent is the product-info drawer or a cart drawer. So I still can't see whether the wishlist header shows a single `WISHLIST` tab, the full product tab set, or close-only. If that frame exists, it's the one node I'd still want.
3. **B4** — brand compliance on the Apple/Google marks. Unchanged, unanswered, and still the only item with legal exposure.

**B3/B6, B7, B8, B10-a, B11 and N2** round out the list. Nothing built yet.
